blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Manila Electric Co. (Meralco) customers will receive a P1.987-billion refund after the Energy Regulatory Commission (ERC) disallowed certain pension and employee benefit expenses the utility charged. In a statement late on Thursday, the ERC said Meralco would implement the refund, which averages P0.1536 per kilowatt-hour (kWh), in the next billing cycle. READ: Meralco seeks okay for fresh P2.64-B refund Meanwhile, residential consumers will receive a higher refund rate of P0.2611 per kWh.
